examples.en: Please erase the mistakes on the board.
examples.zh: 請把黑板上的錯誤擦掉。

examples.en: You can erase the old files to save space.
examples.zh: 你可以刪除舊檔案以節省空間。

examples.en: The computer crashed, and all our records were erased.
examples.zh: 電腦當機了，我們所有的紀錄都被消除。

examples.en: It is hard to erase the bad memories of the accident.
examples.zh: 要抹去那場事故的不良記憶是很困難的。

examples.en: Time cannot completely erase the profound impact of historical events.
examples.zh: 時間無法完全抹滅歷史事件深遠的影響。

examples.en: They live in a fancy house.
examples.zh: 他們住在一棟豪華的房子裡。

examples.en: I had dinner at a fancy restaurant.
examples.zh: 我在一家豪華的餐廳享用晚餐。

examples.en: She bought a fancy dress for the graduation party.
examples.zh: 她買了一件華麗的洋裝去參加畢業派對。

examples.en: He drives a fancy sports car to work every day.
examples.zh: 他每天開著一輛酷炫的跑車去上班。

examples.en: The hotel offers fancy accommodations for international VIP guests.
examples.zh: 該飯店為國際貴賓提供豪華的住宿設施。

examples.en: A flock of birds flew across the blue sky.
examples.zh: 一群鳥飛越藍色的天空。

examples.en: The shepherd watched his flock of sheep.
examples.zh: 牧羊人看守著他的羊群。

examples.en: It is easy to spot flocks of geese as they migrate.
examples.zh: 當成群的野雁遷徙時，很容易發現牠們的蹤跡。

examples.en: Tourists flock to the beach during the summer season.
examples.zh: 夏天時遊客們蜂擁至海灘。

examples.en: A massive flock of migratory birds descended upon the wetlands.
examples.zh: 一大群候鳥降落在濕地上。

examples.en: I need to buy some groceries after work.
examples.zh: 我下班後需要買一些雜貨/日用品。

examples.en: She went to the local grocery store.
examples.zh: 她去了當地的一家雜貨店。

examples.en: I usually do grocery shopping on weekends.
examples.zh: 我通常在週末採買生活用品。

examples.en: He forgot to pick up the milk from the grocery.
examples.zh: 他忘記去雜貨店拿牛奶了。

examples.en: Rising grocery prices have added financial pressure to many households.
examples.zh: 不斷上漲的雜貨價格給許多家庭增加了經濟壓力。

examples.en: The big news made the front-page headline.
examples.zh: 這則大新聞登上了頭條。

examples.en: I only read the headlines of the newspaper.
examples.zh: 我只瀏覽報紙的標題。

examples.en: The scandal became the top headline across the country.
examples.zh: 這起醜聞成為全國各大頭條。

examples.en: The actress hit the headlines by marrying a wealthy man.
examples.zh: 這名女星因嫁入豪門上了頭條新聞。

examples.en: Recent economic reforms have dominated international media headlines.
examples.zh: 近期的經濟改革主導了國際媒體的頭條新聞。

examples.en: He put on his motorcycle helmet.
examples.zh: 他戴上他的機車安全帽。

examples.en: Always wear a helmet when riding a bike.
examples.zh: 騎自行車時務必戴安全帽。

examples.en: Be sure to wear a safety helmet when you ride a motorcycle.
examples.zh: 騎機車一定得戴安全帽。

examples.en: The construction worker forgot to wear his hard helmet.
examples.zh: 那名建築工人忘記戴他的硬安全帽了。

examples.en: Advanced design in sports helmets significantly reduces the risk of concussion.
examples.zh: 運動頭盔的先進設計顯著降低了腦震盪的風險。

examples.en: He felt homesick during his first week abroad.
examples.zh: 他在國外的第一週感到很想家。

examples.en: Studying far away often makes students homesick.
examples.zh: 在遠方求學經常使學生感到思鄉。

examples.en: As I read my mother's letter, I felt more and more homesick.
examples.zh: 當我讀母親的信時，想家的心情愈來愈強烈。

examples.en: She was so homesick that she decided to book an early flight home.
examples.zh: 她是那麼地想家，以至於決定預訂早班機回家。

examples.en: Overcoming chronic homesickness is one of the toughest trials for expatriates.
examples.zh: 克服長期的思鄉之情是外派人員最艱難的考驗之一。

examples.en: We love outdoor activities.
examples.zh: 我們喜歡戶外活動。

examples.en: The hotel has a large outdoor swimming pool.
examples.zh: 這家飯店有一個大型戶外游泳池。

examples.en: He likes outdoor activities such as hiking and camping.
examples.zh: 他喜歡諸如健行和露營等戶外活動。

examples.en: An outdoor market was held in the central square.
examples.zh: 中央廣場舉辦了戶外市集。

examples.en: Participants in the outdoor expedition must prepare proper survival gear.
examples.zh: 戶外探險的參與者必須準備合適的求生裝備。

examples.en: Don't be jealous of other people's success.
examples.zh: 不要嫉妒別人的成功。

examples.en: She felt jealous when he talked to another girl.
examples.zh: 當他和另一個女孩聊天時，她感到吃醋。

examples.en: He has always been very jealous of his brother's good looks.
examples.zh: 他一直都非常妒忌哥哥俊俏的外表。

examples.en: Some colleagues are jealous of her rapid promotion.
examples.zh: 有些同事嫉妒她快速升遷。

examples.en: Unfounded professional jealousy can severely damage team collaboration.
examples.zh: 毫無根據的職場嫉妒會嚴重破壞團隊協作。

examples.en: The children love eating fruit jelly.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡吃水果果凍。

examples.en: I prefer grape jelly over strawberry jam.
examples.zh: 比起草莓果醬，我更喜歡葡萄果凍。

examples.en: I've made a strawberry jelly for the children.
examples.zh: 我做了草莓果凍給小朋友。

examples.en: Americans love peanut butter and jelly sandwich.
examples.zh: 美國人愛吃花生果醬三明治。

examples.en: The dessert chef prepared a delicate gelatin jelly infused with local herbs.
examples.zh: 甜點主廚準備了一款融入當地香草的精緻明膠果凍。

examples.en: The crown is decorated with precious jewels.
examples.zh: 皇冠上裝飾著珍貴的寶石。

examples.en: She wore a shiny jewel on her necklace.
examples.zh: 她的項鍊上戴著一顆閃亮的寶石。

examples.en: She loved dressing up and wearing priceless jewels.
examples.zh: 她愛盛裝打扮並穿戴一些價值不斐的珠寶首飾。

examples.en: The museum exhibits historical jewels from the royal family.
examples.zh: 博物館展出皇室的歷史珠寶。

examples.en: The expert examined the rare jewel under a microscope to verify its authenticity.
examples.zh: 專家在顯微鏡下檢視這顆稀有寶石以驗證其真偽。

examples.en: We need to clear out all the junk in the garage.
examples.zh: 我們需要清理車庫裡所有沒用的東西。

examples.en: Don't buy so much junk food.
examples.zh: 不要買那麼多垃圾食物。

examples.en: The garage is full of junk.
examples.zh: 車庫裡頭塞滿了廢物。

examples.en: Eating too much junk food is not good for your health.
examples.zh: 吃太多垃圾食物對你的健康有害。

examples.en: Sorting through years of accumulated junk proved to be an exhausting task.
examples.zh: 挑選多年累積的雜物證明是一項令人疲憊的工作。

examples.en: Fresh air is good for our lungs.
examples.zh: 新鮮空氣對我們的肺很好。

examples.en: Smoking causes serious damage to human lungs.
examples.zh: 抽菸對人類的肺部造成嚴重的損害。

examples.en: He died of lung cancer.
examples.zh: 他死於肺癌。

examples.en: Deep breathing exercises expand your lung capacity.
examples.zh: 深呼吸運動能擴大你的肺活量。

examples.en: Air pollution poses an aggressive threat to respiratory function and lung tissue.
examples.zh: 空氣汙染對呼吸功能和肺部組織構成嚴重的威脅。

examples.en: The pool is fifty meters long.
examples.zh: 這個游泳池長五十公尺。

examples.en: He jumped over a meter high.
examples.zh: 他跳了一公尺多高。

examples.en: The desk is one meter long, half a meter wide.
examples.zh: 這桌子長一公尺寬半公尺。

examples.en: The electricity meter is behind the door.
examples.zh: 電表在門後。

examples.en: The track and field athlete cleared the high bar set at two meters.
examples.zh: 這名田徑運動員跨越了設定在兩公尺高的橫桿。

examples.en: He tied the rope in a tight knot.
examples.zh: 他把繩子打了一個緊緊的結。

examples.en: Can you untie this knot for me?
examples.zh: 你能幫我解開這個繩結嗎？

examples.en: Are you good at tying knots?
examples.zh: 你擅長綁繩結嗎？

examples.en: Do you know how to knot a bow tie?
examples.zh: 你知道如何打蝴蝶結嗎？

examples.en: Sailors must master various specialized knots to secure vessels safely.
examples.zh: 水手必須掌握各種專門的繩結，以安全固定船隻。

examples.en: Please do not drop litter on the ground.
examples.zh: 請不要在地上亂丟垃圾。

examples.en: The park was full of plastic litter.
examples.zh: 公園裡滿是塑膠垃圾。

examples.en: People who drop litter can be fined in some cities.
examples.zh: 在某些城市亂丟垃圾的人會被罰款。

examples.en: The sign says, "Please Don't litter."
examples.zh: 告示上寫著「請勿亂丟垃圾」。

examples.en: Volunteers gathered over twenty bags of street litter during the weekend cleanup.
examples.zh: 志工在週末的大掃除中收集了二十多袋街道垃圾。

examples.en: They are shopping at the new mall.
examples.zh: 他們正在新購物中心買東西。

examples.en: Let's meet at the mall tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我們明天在購物中心碰面吧！

examples.en: The shopping mall is crowded on weekends.
examples.zh: 週末時購物中心擠滿了人。

examples.en: She works in a clothing store inside the mall.
examples.zh: 她在購物中心裡的一家服飾店工作。

examples.en: Modern shopping malls increasingly incorporate entertainment complexes to attract visitors.
examples.zh: 現代大型購物中心越來越多地結合了娛樂綜合體來吸引遊客。

meaning: 令人驚嘆的、不可思議的

examples.en: We had a marvelous time at the party.
examples.zh: 我們在派對上玩得非常愉快。

examples.en: That is a marvelous idea!
examples.zh: 那真是一個好主意！

examples.en: The Great Wall is a marvelous architectural feat.
examples.zh: 萬里長城是個令人驚嘆的建築物。

examples.en: She did a marvelous job on the presentation.
examples.zh: 她在簡報上的表現令人驚豔。

examples.en: The scientist made a marvelous discovery that changed modern medicine.
examples.zh: 該科學家做出了一項改變現代醫學的驚人發現。

examples.en: He won a gold medal in the race.
examples.zh: 他在比賽中贏得一面金牌。

examples.en: She proudly wore her medal around her neck.
examples.zh: 她驕傲地將獎牌掛在脖子上。

examples.en: She won a gold medal at the last Olympics.
examples.zh: 她在上屆奧運贏得一面金牌。

examples.en: The silver medal and the bronze medal go to Jane and Jack respectively.
examples.zh: 銀牌與銅牌得主分別為珍與傑克。

examples.en: The war veteran was awarded a prestigious military medal for bravery.
examples.zh: 這位退伍軍因英勇表現獲頒聲譽卓著的軍事獎章。

examples.en: Everyone was merry and singing songs.
examples.zh: 每個人都很快樂並且唱著歌。

examples.en: We wished each other a merry Christmas.
examples.zh: 我們互祝聖誕快樂。

examples.en: I wish you a merry Christmas.
examples.zh: 祝你耶誕快樂。

examples.en: Children laughed and played with merry expressions.
examples.zh: 孩子們帶著歡樂的表情嬉戲玩耍。

examples.en: The townspeople gathered in the square to celebrate with merry songs and dances.
examples.zh: 城鎮居民聚集在廣場上，以歡樂的歌舞慶祝。

examples.en: Please speak into the microphone.
examples.zh: 請對著麥克風說話。

examples.en: The singer held the microphone tightly.
examples.zh: 歌手緊緊握著麥克風。

examples.en: She spoke confidently into the microphone.
examples.zh: 她自信地對著麥克風說話。

examples.en: The teacher's microphone stopped working during the lecture.
examples.zh: 老師的麥克風在講課途中故障了。

examples.en: A high-sensitivity microphone can pick up subtle acoustic nuances from a distance.
examples.zh: 高靈敏度麥克風可以遠距離收錄微小的聲學細微差別。

examples.en: You can heat up the food in the microwave.
examples.zh: 你可以用微波爐把食物加熱。

examples.en: I bought a new microwave yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天買了一台新微波爐。

examples.en: I always heat up my lunch in the microwave oven.
examples.zh: 我都用微波爐加熱便當。

examples.en: Some foods taste terrible after they are microwaved.
examples.zh: 有些食物微波之後很難吃。

examples.en: Microwave technology has revolutionized how quickly we prepare daily meals.
examples.zh: 微波技術徹底改變了我們準備日常餐點的速度。

examples.en: He likes to take a nap in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 他喜歡在下午睡個午覺。

examples.en: The baby is taking a nap right now.
examples.zh: 寶寶現在正在睡午覺。

examples.en: I often take a nap after lunch.
examples.zh: 我常在午餐後小睡片刻。

examples.en: Children under two nap both in the morning and in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 兩歲以下的小孩早上和下午都會小睡一下。

examples.en: Taking a short power nap can significantly boost afternoon work efficiency.
examples.zh: 小睡片刻可以顯著提升下午的工作效率。

examples.en: He turned up his coat collar against the wind.
examples.zh: 他豎起外套衣領來擋風。

examples.en: The dog's collar has its name on it.
examples.zh: 這隻狗的項圈上有它的名字。

examples.en: The wind was so cold that he turned his coat collar up.
examples.zh: 風太冷了，所以他把外套的領子立起來。

examples.en: He grabbed the puppy by its red collar.
examples.zh: 他抓着小狗紅色的項圈。

examples.en: Government statistics show that hourly earnings of white-collar workers are about 30% higher.
examples.zh: 政府統計資料顯示，白領階級的時薪比藍領階級高三成。

examples.en: He has been my best pal for years.
examples.zh: 多年來他一直是我的好朋友。

examples.en: Hey pal, how are you doing today?
examples.zh: 嘿，老兄，你今天過得怎麼樣？

examples.en: I am so happy to see my old pal Martin.
examples.zh: 我真高興與老馬丁碰面了。

examples.en: Hi, pal, please keep your voice down.
examples.zh: 嗨，兄弟，說話請小聲點。

examples.en: Finding a reliable pen pal can greatly enrich language learning experiences.
examples.zh: 找到一位可靠的筆友可以極大地豐富語言學習體驗。

examples.en: We ate pancakes with maple syrup for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我們早餐吃了加楓糖漿的鬆餅。

examples.en: She made some delicious pancakes this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上做了些美味的煎餅。

examples.en: Would you like your pancake with syrup or cream?
examples.zh: 你的鬆餅要配糖漿還是奶油？

examples.en: Most Americans like to eat doughnuts and pancakes.
examples.zh: 大部分的美國人喜歡吃甜甜圈和鬆餅。

examples.en: The culinary student mastered flipping thin pancakes on a hot skillet.
examples.zh: 這位烹飪系學生精通了在熱平底鍋上翻轉薄煎餅的技巧。

examples.en: The mailman delivered a heavy parcel to our door.
examples.zh: 郵差送了一個沉重的包裹到我們家門口。

examples.en: I need to mail this parcel to my parents.
examples.zh: 我需要把這個包裹寄給我的父母。

examples.en: The parcel was wrapped in plain brown paper.
examples.zh: 那個包裹裏用普通的牛皮紙包裹着。

examples.en: She parceled the letters and put them in the drawer.
examples.zh: 她將信件紮好並放進抽屜。

examples.en: Customs officials inspected every international parcel for restricted items.
examples.zh: 海關官員檢查了每一個國際包裹中的違禁物品。

examples.en: You must show your passport at the airport.
examples.zh: 你必須在機場出示你的護照。

examples.en: I forgot to bring my passport for the trip.
examples.zh: 我旅行忘了帶護照。

examples.en: He was a German, traveling on a Swiss passport.
examples.zh: 他是德國人，持瑞士護照旅行。

examples.en: Make sure your passport is valid for at least six months.
examples.zh: 確保你的護照效期至少還有六個月。

examples.en: Losing your passport while traveling abroad can cause severe administrative delays.
examples.zh: 在國外旅行時遺失護照可能會造成嚴重的行政延誤。

examples.en: I feel pity for stray animals.
examples.zh: 我對流浪動物感到同情。

examples.en: It is a pity that you can't come.
examples.zh: 真遺憾你不能來。

examples.en: I pity her for having to work while we are on vacation.
examples.zh: 我同情她在我們度假的時候必須工作。

examples.en: How can you marry the man out of pity?
examples.zh: 怎麼能因同情而嫁給這個人？

examples.en: Rather than seeking pity, she overcame her hardships through sheer determination.
examples.zh: 她沒有尋求同情，而是憑藉純粹的決心克服了艱難。

examples.en: Factories should not pollute the river.
examples.zh: 工廠不應該污染河流。

examples.en: Plastic waste can seriously pollute the ocean.
examples.zh: 塑膠垃圾會嚴重污染海洋。

examples.en: His mind is polluted by hatred.
examples.zh: 仇恨汙染他的心智。

examples.en: Chemical waste from the plant polluted the local water supply.
examples.zh: 工廠的化學廢料污染了當地的供水。

examples.en: Unregulated industrial discharge continues to pollute fragile coastal ecosystems.
examples.zh: 不受規範的工業排放持續汙染脆弱的沿海生態系統。

examples.en: Fallen leaves will rot in the soil.
examples.zh: 落葉會在土壤中腐爛。

examples.en: Keep the fruit dry so it won't rot.
examples.zh: 保持水果乾燥才不會腐壞。

examples.en: Rain has got in and rotted the woodwork.
examples.zh: 雨水滲進來，腐蝕了木造的部分。

examples.en: Remove decaying vegetables to prevent rot from spreading.
examples.zh: 移除腐爛的蔬菜，以防腐壞情況擴散。

examples.en: High humidity and poor ventilation accelerate food spoilage and organic rot.
examples.zh: 高濕度和通風不良會加速食物變質和有機腐敗。

examples.en: The old gate was covered with rust.
examples.zh: 舊大門佈滿了鐵鏽。

examples.en: Metal will rust if left in the rain.
examples.zh: 金屬如果淋雨會生鏽。

examples.en: The spade was covered with rust.
examples.zh: 那鏟子上布滿鐵鏽。

examples.en: Iron rusts easily in moist environments.
examples.zh: 鐵在潮濕環境中容易生鏽。

examples.en: Protective coatings are applied to steel structures to prevent oxidation and rust.
examples.zh: 在鋼結構上塗上保護塗層以防止氧化和生鏽。

meaning: 大袋子 (用以運送水泥、穀物等)

examples.en: He carried a heavy sack of potatoes.
examples.zh: 他扛了一大袋馬鈴薯。

examples.en: The farmer filled sacks with wheat.
examples.zh: 農夫把袋子裝滿小麥。

examples.en: The corn was stored in large sacks.
examples.zh: 玉米被存放在大袋子里。

examples.en: Workers loaded sacks of rice onto the truck.
examples.zh: 工人們將一袋袋的米裝上卡車。

examples.en: Heavy-duty burlap sacks are traditionally used for transporting coffee beans.
examples.zh: 耐用的麻袋傳統上用於運輸咖啡豆。

examples.en: I need to buy a bottle of shampoo.
examples.zh: 我需要買一瓶洗髮精。

examples.en: This shampoo smells like flowers.
examples.zh: 這款洗髮精聞起來像花香。

examples.en: You need a gentle shampoo for your baby's fine hair.
examples.zh: 你需要溫和的洗髮精來清潔寶寶柔細的頭髮。

examples.en: Can I use shower gel to shampoo my hair?
examples.zh: 可以用沐浴露洗頭髮嗎？

examples.en: Dermatologists recommend organic botanical shampoo for sensitive scalps.
examples.zh: 皮膚科醫生建議敏感性頭皮使用有機植物洗髮精。

examples.en: The shepherd watched over his flock in the field.
examples.zh: 牧羊人在田野裡看守他的羊群。

examples.en: A dog helped the shepherd guide the sheep.
examples.zh: 一隻狗協助牧羊人引導羊群。

examples.en: The shepherd herds his sheep down the mountain.
examples.zh: 牧羊人驅趕綿羊下山。

examples.en: A sheepdog can do twenty shepherds' job.
examples.zh: 一隻牧羊犬可以做二十個牧羊人的工作。

examples.en: The experienced shepherd navigated the rugged terrain with his loyal collie.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的牧羊人帶著他的忠實牧羊犬在崎嶇的地形中前行。

examples.en: Be careful not to slip on the ice.
examples.zh: 小心不要在冰上滑倒。

examples.en: He slipped and fell on the wet floor.
examples.zh: 他在濕地板上滑倒了。

examples.en: The ground was so wet that I almost slipped.
examples.zh: 地上很溼，我差一點滑倒。

examples.en: The glass slipped out of my hand and smashed on the floor.
examples.zh: 玻璃杯從我手中滑落，碎了一地。

examples.en: It is not unusual to have a slip of the tongue when you talk really fast.
examples.zh: 說話很快時難免會有口誤。

examples.en: She felt deep sorrow after losing her pet.
examples.zh: 失去寵物後她感到深深的悲傷。

examples.en: Words cannot express my sorrow.
examples.zh: 言辭無法表達我的悲傷。

examples.en: He expressed his sorrow at my father's death.
examples.zh: 他對我父親的去世表達哀悼之情。

examples.en: The community shared their sorrow over the tragic accident.
examples.zh: 社區居民為這場悲慘事故分擔他們的悲傷。

examples.en: Time eventually heals the profound sorrow associated with the loss of a loved one.
examples.zh: 時間最終會治癒失去摯愛所帶來的深切悲傷。

examples.en: The spy shared secret information with the enemy.
examples.zh: 間諜與敵人分享了機密資訊。

examples.en: He was caught acting as a foreign spy.
examples.zh: 他因擔任外國間諜而被捕。

examples.en: He was suspected of having been a spy during the war.
examples.zh: 他遭懷疑曾在戰時擔任間諜。

examples.en: The woman hired a private detective to spy on her husband.
examples.zh: 這名女子僱用一名私家偵探監視丈夫。

examples.en: The clandestine agent operated deep undercover as an enemy spy for decades.
examples.zh: 這名祕密特工以敵方間諜身分深入臥底數十年。

examples.en: The baseball stadium was packed with fans.
examples.zh: 棒球場擠滿了球迷。

examples.en: A huge concert was held in the national stadium.
examples.zh: 國家體育場舉辦了一場巨大的音樂會。

examples.en: Thousands of football fans packed into the stadium to watch the game.
examples.zh: 幾千名球迷擠進運動場來看球賽。

examples.en: We played basketball in the gymnasium.
examples.zh: 我們在體育館打籃球。

examples.en: The multi-purpose stadium hosts both international track meets and soccer tournaments.
examples.zh: 這座多功能體育場舉辦國際田徑賽事和足球錦標賽。

examples.en: He sat on a wooden stool at the bar.
examples.zh: 他坐在吧台的一張木凳上。

examples.en: She stood on a small stool to reach the shelf.
examples.zh: 她站在小凳子上以搆到架子。

examples.en: The man fetched a stool and sat with the others.
examples.zh: 那個人拿了一把凳子和其他人坐在一起。

examples.en: A stool test can help diagnose problems in the digestive tract.
examples.zh: 糞便檢查有助於診斷消化道的問題。

examples.en: Laboratory technicians analyzed the biological sample collected during the stool examination.
examples.zh: 實驗室技術人員分析了在糞便檢查期間採集的生物樣本。
